report.title: Click shortcut edit button is not pop a edit dialog
report.body:
### Pre-submission Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this bug has not been reported yet
- [x] I have tested this issue on the [demo site](https://demo.usememos.com) or the latest version

### Where did you encounter this bug?

Latest stable version (self-hosted)

### Memos Version

v0.26.0

### Bug Description

Just see in this image:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a145f714-85e2-4b29-a476-cf26c53e9518)

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Add a item in shortcut
2. Click the menu of this item, and choose edit option
3. Pop a create dialog, Not a edit dialog

### Expected Behavior

Click edit button and then just pop a edit dialog.

### Screenshots & Additional Context

_No response_

preconditions: the user is signed in with no existing shortcuts
the sidebar has a Shortcuts section with an option to add a shortcut
steps: Click the add (+) button in the Shortcuts section of the sidebar
Enter a title for the new shortcut and a filter if the dialog requires one
Click the confirm/create button to save the shortcut
Click the menu (three-dot) button next to the new shortcut item in the sidebar
Click the 'Edit' option in the menu
plan.expected: After clicking Edit, a dialog titled for editing a shortcut (e.g. 'Edit Shortcut') is shown, pre-filled with the existing shortcut's values, rather than a create-shortcut dialog
plan.reported_actual: Clicking Edit in the shortcut item's menu opens a create-shortcut dialog instead of an edit dialog
missing: What title and filter values were used when creating the shortcut?
What exact title does the dialog show (the screenshot is not readable)?
assumed: the shortcut was created through the '+' button in the sidebar Shortcuts section
assumed: the shortcut title/filter values are arbitrary since the reporter gave none
Does the issue happen on every shortcut or only after a page reload?
plan.summary: Choosing Edit from a shortcut's menu opens a create dialog instead of an edit dialog

# Click shortcut edit button is not pop a edit dialog

## Sign in
Sign in with username {{username}} and password {{password}}.
Verify the sign-in form is gone and the memo app's main page is shown.

## Reproduce the report
Open http://localhost:15308/.
Stay on localhost:15308 for the whole run and do not open any other website.
Do each step once, in order. If the app behaves unexpectedly, do not undo, retry, repair or work around it: the behavior itself is what is being checked. Check the result right after the last step.
Steps:
1. Click the add (+) button in the Shortcuts section of the sidebar
2. Enter a title for the new shortcut and a filter if the dialog requires one
3. Click the confirm/create button to save the shortcut
4. Click the menu (three-dot) button next to the new shortcut item in the sidebar
5. Click the 'Edit' option in the menu
The reporter says the correct behavior is that After clicking Edit, a dialog titled for editing a shortcut (e.g. 'Edit Shortcut') is shown, pre-filled with the existing shortcut's values, rather than a create-shortcut dialog. Verify that After clicking Edit, a dialog titled for editing a shortcut (e.g. 'Edit Shortcut') is shown, pre-filled with the existing shortcut's values, rather than a create-shortcut dialog.

verdict.headline: Kane saw a mismatch at the final check but judged it a problem with the steps or the expectation, not the app. The report may be missing detail.
verdict.stuck_at: Save left the Create Shortcuts dialog open, so no new sidebar shortcut exists for the required menu action.

run.reason: Save left the Create Shortcuts dialog open, so no new sidebar shortcut exists for the required menu action.
run.summary:
The agent recognized that the dialog required a filter but did not enter the required `@v16:"a filter"` value. It then clicked Save with only the title filled in, so the dialog correctly remained open and no shortcut was available to edit.
Update the automation to enter `@v16:"a filter"` in the Filter field after detecting that it is required, then click Save and verify that the shortcut appears before attempting its menu action.

Run again with a valid shortcut-filter expression, then create the shortcut once and verify the Edit dialog.
